subject: Review: RPG Scan #002 governance recommendations — 4 decisions

R1_quorum_tiers.rationale: Aligns with the ACK protocol evolution we proposed earlier this session. C1 eliminates receipt ACKs (HTTP 201 suffices). C2 unblocks most directives. C3 reserved for breaking changes.
R1_quorum_tiers.implementation: Add consensus_tier field to transport messages. meshd-sync auto-classifies: ack_required=false → C1, ack_required=true → C2, enforcement='mandatory' → C3. Gate resolution checks tier thresholds.

R2_stale_sessions.rationale: Closing sessions loses context. Stale sessions represent deferred work, not completed work. Auto-closing creates risk of losing track of unfinished obligations. Instead: flag with 'stale' status in MANIFEST, surface in dashboard with visual indicator, but never auto-close or auto-transition.
R2_stale_sessions.implementation: meshd cron checks session MANIFEST timestamps. If no new turns in 14+ days, set status='stale' in MANIFEST (not 'closing' or 'closed'). Dashboard shows stale indicator. Human decides when to close.

R3_observatory_gap.decision: INVESTIGATING — root cause analysis in progress
R3_observatory_gap.rationale: We just worktree-merged 9 observatory PRs this session and deployed auto-merge in meshd-sync. The agent now has all directives in its repo. Investigation running: checking meshd logs, budget, spawn capability, and transport state.
R3_observatory_gap.interim: Option (c) — remove observatory from unanimity gates until processing resumes. Apply C2 tier (3-of-5 quorum) to all current open gates retroactively.

R4_rate_limit_broadcasts.rationale: Session 4 sent 9+ directives because it addressed accumulated debt (security audit, vocabulary rename, psychometrics rollout, delivery convention, schema parity, content-publish-flow). This represents a burst, not a steady state. The meshd-sync pre-spawn triage (skip if nothing to process) already reduces unnecessary spawns. Batching directives would require holding messages — which delays the mesh. Prefer: agents process asynchronously at their own rate (enabled by C1/C2 tiers).
R4_rate_limit_broadcasts.alternative: The quorum tier system (R1) effectively solves this — C1 directives require no response, so agents absorb them passively without spawn overhead.

epistemic_flags: R3 investigation ongoing — observatory root cause not yet determined
